title: Cold rebuild: at most N at a time
summary: The throttled fetch again, from an empty editor.

steps.title: From memory
body: Rebuild `FetchAllAsync` from *Throttling with SemaphoreSlim and Parallel.ForEachAsync*: an empty editor, no hints, the same tests.
The parts people forget: the slot is released in `finally`, the wait is *outside* the `try`, and the results keep the input order.

options: Before the `try`, so a cancelled wait (which got no slot) does not release one
steps.explain: If `WaitAsync` throws, you never had a slot; releasing in `finally` would hand out one slot too many.

steps.title: Rebuild FetchAllAsync cold
prompt: Write `static async Task<List<string>> FetchAllAsync(IReadOnlyList<string> urls, Func<string, CancellationToken, Task<string>> fetch, int maxConcurrent, CancellationToken ct)`:
every url fetched, at most `maxConcurrent` in flight (and using all of them), results in the order of `urls`, `ct` passed on.
